description: This file manages checkpoint-related functionalities in a VSCode extension, including creating, restoring, diffing, and error reporting for checkpoints, as well as integrating with Git and VSCode APIs.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Captures and reports an error event with callsite and error details.

methods.name: sendCheckpointInitWarn
methods.description: Sends a warning message to the webview about checkpoint initialization status.

methods.name: getCheckpointService
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves the checkpoint service for a task, handling timeouts and Git checks.

methods.name: checkGitInstallation
methods.description: Checks if Git is installed and initializes shadow Git, handling errors and user notifications.

methods.name: checkpointSave
methods.description: Creates a checkpoint for a task, capturing telemetry and handling errors.

methods.name: checkpointRestore
methods.description: Restores a checkpoint for a task, updating messages and metrics, with error handling.

methods.name: checkpointDiff
methods.description: Computes and displays differences between checkpoints or workspace states, with error handling.
